content.page_summary: Reference list (items 112–119) focused on use of copeptin, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin (I and T), coronary CT angiography, and troponin-guided imaging strategies for diagnosis, rule-out, and prognosis of myocardial infarction and acute coronary syndromes.
